title: Timeout at zero budget
statement: Let $x$ be a finite Boolean input word, let $cfg$ be a four-tape configuration over $x$, let $bs$ be a finite Boolean clock word, let $bits$ assign a Boolean to each index below $8$, and let $halt$ be a Boolean flag. Suppose $cfg$ has the pending-action control carrying $bits$ and $halt$, and the little-endian value of $bs$ is zero. After exactly $2|bs|+3$ steps from the six-tape lift of $cfg$ with clock word $bs$, the timed interpreter is halted and its real output is exactly the one-bit word $[0]$.
hypotheses_covered: A four-tape configuration over $x$ whose control is the specified pending-action state
A finite Boolean clock word $bs$ with little-endian value zero
A Boolean action-bit function indexed below 8
replaced:
If the clock word $w$ has little-endian value $0$, then after $2|w| + 3$ steps
of the timed interpreter from the six-tape lift of a pending-action
configuration, the machine has halted with real output exactly the single
timeout tag $0$, regardless of any emissions buffered so far.
